plugins.name: ace
plugins.description: v7.1.4: Concurrent-subagent degenerate-trace fix. No floor bump. Stage 1 — agent_id recovery: if SubagentStop delivers an empty agent_id (high fan-out via Task/Workflow tool), recover it from the agent_transcript_path filename BEFORE state-file reads. Stage 2 — hygiene skip: fully anchorless + promptless SubagentStop traces are skipped (reap + subagent_degenerate_skip telemetry + exit 0) instead of polluting the server. Precision: never skips a trace with ANY anchor or real prompt. v7.1.3: Subagent session-anchoring correctness + SubagentStop observability. No floor bump. R2: unconditional task_session_id seed. R1: SubagentStop invariant monitor. v7.1.2: Injection quality + correctness hardening. Quality gate keep iff NOT isAtRisk AND cumulative_v15_reward >= 0. Domain-shift bounded server-side via --top-k 8. Floor bump: ace-cli >= 4.1.2, @ace-sdk/core >= 3.2.2. v7.1.1: Domain-shift session-pinning + strip/gate hardening. Floor bump: ace-cli >= 4.1.2, Claude Code >= 2.1.163, @ace-sdk/core >= 3.2.2. v7.1.0: Per-agent ACE attribution. v7.0.0: ACE 1.5 / ace-cli 4.0.1 compatibility milestone. Requires: Claude Code >= 2.1.163, ace-cli >= 4.1.2 (@ace-sdk/core >= 3.2.2).
